description: Ends a session started by gamealia_playtest (waits for its pending action, then closes the browser page; the session id stops working) and returns the summary: verdict pass/warn/fail with a message, steps and how many got a response, whether gameplay started, happy times, ad requests and ads shown, console errors and whether it crashed. Call it when done playing, so the session does not hold a browser until it expires.
name: gamealia_playtest_stop
title: Stop a playtest
